cdr_pino.early_stop: val AUC, check every 5 ep, patience 4 checks
cdr_pino.architecture: FNO2d lift 8->32, 4 x (SpectralConv 16x16 + 1x1 skip, GELU), proj 32->32->1; D_net 2-12-12-1 tanh; rho_net 4-12-12-1 tanh; c_adv scalar
cdr_pino.loss: adaptive-balanced sum of data (pos-weighted BCE + LSE terminal), PDE residual MSE, BC |grad u|^2 on boundary ring, IC (identically 0)
cdr_pino.environment: cdr_pinn_env, torch 2.11.0+cu128, NVIDIA RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell

splits.B1: 3 folds, CDR-PINO 2 deg block permutation (seed 42), block-carved validation
splits.B2: 6 KMeans regions on 12 km valid cells (random_state 42); 1 km pixels by nearest centroid
